scope: Three source root causes. No generated-artifact edits, new suppressions, dependency changes or edits to concurrent search-palette work.

rootCauses.name: Collapsible drawer icon identity
rootCauses.impact: Low-severity visual reliability risk: parent updates replaced the expand/collapse icon DOM and restarted custom icon state. No production flicker or navigation failure claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Hoist both icon components to module scope and pass content explicitly. Preserve custom icon names/URLs/spread precedence, default chevrons, initial openedPath state and toggle behavior.
rootCauses.tests: Both initially-open and initially-closed identity tests failed before the fix; now preserve DOM identity and verify configured URLs, title updates and click-driven state/icon changes.

rootCauses.name: Google Forms proxy HTTP errors
rootCauses.impact: HTTP error HTML was returned as if it were successful form content. No active internal caller found; defensive reliability fix, not a confirmed live-page outage.
rootCauses.fix: Check response.ok before reading text and throw a status-only error. Preserve proxy URL encoding, trimmed source URL, unsupported-input empty result, successful HTML and network errors.
rootCauses.tests: Four pre-fix failures for 403/404/429/500 now reject before body consumption. Success/proxy URL, unsupported URL and network-error tests pass.

rootCauses.name: Instagram helper HTTP errors
rootCauses.impact: HTTP failures could appear as missing users or successful list data. No active internal caller found; live-site impact unestablished.
rootCauses.fix: Check response.ok before JSON consumption in both user lookup and list fetching. Preserve request URLs/options, exact username matching, successful missing-user undefined, successful list payloads and original network failures.
rootCauses.tests: Both helper regressions failed before the fix. Each now rejects 401/404/429/500 without reading JSON; successful lookup/list and network errors remain covered.

recipeReview: Fetched all three canonical pages with no-cache curl headers and read validation/false-positive criteria. Confirmed actual JSX component use and DOM remounts; HTTP tests confirm success-shaped handling of error statuses. Fixes follow module-scope identity and response.ok-before-body recipes.
grouping: No fixGroupId on selected diagnostics. Four duplicate nesting diagnostics grouped as one drawer icon lifecycle root cause; two Instagram response sites grouped as one helper HTTP handling root cause.

validation.tests: 15 tests pass across 3 files; 8 cases failed before implementation. Instagram error cases each cover four HTTP statuses.

validation.eslint: Zero errors; one pre-existing unused react/no-unused-prop-types suppression warning in CollapsibleListSection.tsx:22, left untouched.
validation.format: Prettier check and git diff --check pass
validation.limitations: No production rebuild, live-provider calls or real-browser checks. Drawer tests use happy-dom and mocked icons/collapse; HTTP tests use real Response objects and mocked fetch.
